petg_general_0p4.supports: off unless a job override says otherwise
petg_general_0p4.bed_adhesion: Clean textured PEI; use a 5 mm brim only after observed corner lift
petg_general_0p4.dimensional_controls: Use calibrated elephant-foot and XY-hole compensation from the diagnostic coupons
petg_general_0p4.purpose: Trays, cradle, clamps, frames, puck, and camera plate

petg_tray_structural_0p4.bed_adhesion: Clean textured PEI; 6 mm brim recommended for the two large tray halves
petg_tray_structural_0p4.dimensional_controls: Keep slicer seam away from mounting slots, male keys, female pocket mouths, and keyboard datums
petg_tray_structural_0p4.purpose: Keyboard tray halves with reinforced seam and support rails

petg_cradle_0p4.supports: build-plate only under horizontal clamp bores if needed
petg_cradle_0p4.bed_adhesion: 5 mm brim recommended around the asymmetric cradle and clamp towers
petg_cradle_0p4.dimensional_controls: Use the horizontal M4 insert coupon; ream the 4.6 mm passages by hand after printing

petg_precision_0p4.bed_adhesion: 5 mm brim around the upright tool body; remove carefully from the cap
petg_precision_0p4.dimensional_controls: Keep the slicer seam off the gripper flats and sliding guide bore

petg_calibration_0p4.bed_adhesion: Skirt normally sufficient on clean textured PEI
petg_calibration_0p4.dimensional_controls: Do not enable ironing over the crosshair or central divot

petg_adapter_0p4.bed_adhesion: Use an 8 mm brim for the upright rod bushing; skirt is sufficient for the short collar
petg_adapter_0p4.dimensional_controls: Calibrate elephant-foot compensation so split bores remain open at the first layer
petg_adapter_0p4.purpose: Fit-sensitive stylus collar and rod bushing

tpu95a_0p4.bed_adhesion: Clean PEI with no glue unless required by the exact TPU; use a 3 mm brim if a tip rocks
tpu95a_0p4.dimensional_controls: Dry filament and keep first-layer flow calibrated so the flared bore entries remain open

asa_structural_0p4.supports: build-plate only under transverse bores if needed
asa_structural_0p4.bed_adhesion: 10 mm brim, enclosed printer, stable chamber, and no drafts
asa_structural_0p4.dimensional_controls: Use the ASA socket and nut coupons from the same spool before the first full foot
asa_structural_0p4.purpose: Optional camera mast feet; calibrate shrink before full print

structural_fast_0p6_optional.supports: off unless validated for the selected structural part
structural_fast_0p6_optional.purpose: Optional later production profile for trays and mast feet; requires fresh fit validation

rules.temperature_policy: Use a calibrated QIDI Studio filament preset for the exact brand and material; temperatures are deliberately not embedded in geometry-only 3MF files.
rules.speed_policy: Prioritize dimensional accuracy: keep outer walls and small-hole features at the calibrated quality-profile speeds rather than the printer maximum.
